question: What extra structural information is required beyond the exact W/D/L support-event quotient to preserve the set G(s) of perfect-play P0 terminal winning-line labels?

4x3_witness.reason: In A the bottom line remains live for P0; in B P1 owns A1 and kills that original line. Minimal residual antichain identity merges the histories because another line supplies the same existential residual requirement.

candidate_exact_overlay.definition: Pi0(r) is the set of original P0 geometric-line labels whose current live residual is exactly residual ID r.
candidate_exact_overlay.value_projection: The ordinary P0 W/D/L residual antichain is obtained by forgetting provenance and minimizing the residual-ID domain.
candidate_exact_overlay.P0_move: For every provenance group whose residual contains x, move its origin labels to residual r\{x}; if the residual becomes empty, those origin labels are the terminal output labels. Other groups remain.
candidate_exact_overlay.P1_move: Delete every P0 provenance group whose residual contains x; those original lines are permanently killed.
candidate_exact_overlay.duplicate_residual_merge: Groups with the same exact residual ID may merge by union of origin-label sets.
candidate_exact_overlay.antichain_guard: Strict-superset provenance groups may not be discarded merely because a smaller residual suffices for W/D/L existential completion; terminal-line identity is a richer objective.

interpretation: The support-event/minimal-antichain quotient is exact for W/D/L but not for perfect-play terminal-line identity G.
The failure is provenance loss, not a failure of the underlying W/D/L equivalence theorem.
Exact P0 line-to-residual provenance removes every observed G collision across all four complete small-game controls.
A count-only per-line overlay is not generally sufficient; complete 4x4, 5x3, and 4x5 controls retain mixed-G classes.

For the standard-7x6 28-line output objective, value proof and output attribution should remain separate layers: WSL antichains for W/D/L, plus a P0 provenance overlay for which original geometric lines survive/complete.
anti_leakage: No standard-7x6 perfect-play terminal-line subset, witness sequence, or solved-state table was used.
